profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at Illumina
profile.summary: Full Stack Developer, with a desire to learn.  Well versed in .Net, Nodejs and various SQL and NoSQL databases. Familiar and comfortable with a fast paced environment developing quality focused solutions. Fluent with the AWS stack and proven development patterns.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
Led various agile teams working with stakeholders across the business to architect and build quality enterprise solutions.  I was able to re-invent our cloud deployment practices utilizing tools such as Terraform and various CI/CD products to efficiently and effectively scale our products across multiple AWS environments. With a focus on AWS Cloud technologies I was able to employ serverless practices reducing operating expenses while increasing productivity and scalability.

Architected and built out the platform for transitioning existing .Net Framework microservice-microserver products to a docker solution effectively reducing the server costs by over 50%.

Built the company's first mobile application using Ionic framework where upon I was able to deliver a highly available and adaptable mobile solution. 

Architected and implemented various business critical services, supporting processes from geospatial analysis reporting to application and bonding of assessments.

positions.description: Worked directly with clients implementing Salesforce software and organization solutions, including writing tests and developing multi-tenant/cloud compliant code on a strict time frame.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description: I was a member of the Development team where I aided in production of web application features and managed small projects delegated.  I also served as a website Traffic Analyst using Google Analytics to provide value feedback regarding the success of various advertising techniques.

projects.title: Facial Recognition System
projects.description:
• Implementing a facial recognition system and network to provide hospital security and patient safety • Using check-in, mobile, and stationary cameras to send facial images to a server
• Server will compare faces to the database and return a notification with the appropriate information
• Using Microsoft Visual Studio C# and SQL Server for code design and implementation

projects.title: FreeRTOS_Smart Cube
projects.description: The main purpose of this project is to interface between the LPC1758 development board and the RN-XV WiFly wifi module and between the LPC1758 and the 8x8 RGB LED matrix. The Smart Cube is an 8x8 RGB LED RTC clock, that also provides the user with the weather, email count, and a programmable alarm. The Smart Cube can be accessed via its local Website and its Windows Phone 8 mobile application. From the website and mobile app the user can set the alarm, set the alarm melody, set the city to get the weather, define the email credentials, and set other functional features. The 8x8 RGB LED clock allows for the information to be displayed in any color, and dynamic.
